name: qwen3-235b-a22b
description: Qwen3-235B-A22B achieves effective integration of thinking mode and non-thinking mode, allowing seamless switching between modes during conversations. Its reasoning capability significantly surpasses QwQ, while its general capability significantly exceeds Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, reaching industry SOTA level at the same scale.
zhDescription: Qwen3-235B-A22B实现了思考模式和非思考模式的有效融合，可在对话中切换模式。推理能力显著超过QwQ、通用能力显著超过Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct，达到同规模业界SOTA水平。
longDescription: Qwen3-235B-A22B achieves effective integration of thinking mode and non-thinking mode, allowing seamless switching between modes during conversations. Its reasoning capability significantly surpasses QwQ, while its general capability significantly exceeds Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, reaching industry SOTA level at the same scale.
zhLongDescription: Qwen3-235B-A22B实现了思考模式和非思考模式的有效融合，可在对话中切换模式。推理能力显著超过QwQ、通用能力显著超过Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct，达到同规模业界SOTA水平。
